metadata.question: From January to mid-May, did Jaén a few miles east of Córdoba recieve more than 3 inches of rain fall in 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Jaén (a few miles east of Córdoba, Spain) - I'll use coordinates around Jaén, Spain (~37.77°N, 3.79°W) - Time: January to mid-May 2023 (2023-01-01 to 2023-05-15) - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is ideal for rainfall data, or GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) - I'll use CHIRPS daily precipitation data 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data - Just sum up all precipitation values for the period 3. Logic: - Sum total precipitation for Jan-May 15, 2023 - Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) - Check if > 3 inches (76.2 mm) - Valid Zero: If precipitation is 0, that's a valid answer (B: No) - C1: If no images found in the collection - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels (unlikely for CHIRPS) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If > 3 inches, B: If <= 3 inches ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Jaén, Spain (east of Córdoba) const jaen = ee.Geometry.Point([-3.79, 37.77]); const startDate = '2023-01-01'; const endDate = '2023-05-15'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const precipitation = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(jaen); const imageCount = precipitation.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum all precipitation const totalPrecip = precipitation.sum(); // 4. Calculation const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: jaen, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const precipMm = stats.precipitation; // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: jaen, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const validPixels = pixelCount.precipitation; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validPixels}`); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log("Calculation returned invalid value."); console.log("C3"); return; } const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; const threshold = 3.0; console.log(`Total rainfall: ${precipMm.toFixed(2)} mm (${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold} inches`); if (precipInches > threshold) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
